why: Both analyses reach nearly the same diagnosis as the key: growth-for-size with no real hedgehog, the same four brutal facts, and a stop-doing list covering size, new ventures, branches and energy/shipping/developing-country lending, though neither mentions executive perks. Analysis 2 is slightly better calibrated: it labels the bank "good, in early decline" rather than "great-at-risk-of-falling", marks missing data without inventing numeric targets, and gives a tighter verdict.
